scope: Independent verification of a large inferred cash event flagged during total-return reconstruction; not a complete dividend register.

sources.title: 景顺长城中证红利低波动100交易型开放式指数证券投资基金分红公告
sources.evidence: Page 1: fund code 515100, cash distribution 4.37 yuan per ten shares, record date 2023-12-20, ex-date 2023-12-21, payment date 2023-12-26. Page 2 confirms cash-only distribution.

cash_events.interpretation: The 25.53% figure is distribution size relative to the previous market close, not an investment return. Adding the verified cash dividend to the ex-date close gives a close-to-close holding return of about -0.1168%, before reinvestment timing and trading costs.

limitations: Actual cash becomes available on the payment date, not on the ex-date; immediate ex-date reinvestment remains a research convention.
